name: Habits
overview: Scripture reveals that habits deeply shape a person's character and spiritual life, as seen in the call to attentively listen and follow godly instruction (Proverbs 4:20) and the promise that early training leads to steadfastness in righteousness (Proverbs 22:6). Yet, the difficulty of changing ingrained patterns is acknowledged, likened to the impossibility of a leopard changing its spots (Jeremiah 13:23). True transformation requires daily self-denial and surrender to Christ (Luke 9:23), presenting oneself wholly to God as a living sacrifice (Romans 12:1), recognizing that what flows from within defines one’s purity or defilement (Mark 7:20). This underscores both the challenge of breaking bad habits and the necessity of relying on Christ’s power for lasting change.
